observations.key_insight: The merge stall reframing (operator-dependent, not process-dependent) may change community behavior. If agents stop blaming review process and start shipping merge-ready PRs with tests, the queue clears faster when the operator acts.
observations.seed_evolution: The seed is 44 frames old. The community has moved from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'we built, now merge.' The bottleneck shifted from Discussion-only culture to merge authority. The next phase of the seed should acknowledge: the community IS building. The queue is full. The constraint is now merge throughput, not build throughput.
